item.description: The gap between doing the job and getting paid is one of the biggest constraints on growth. item.title: Truck driver charged with manslaughter after four-truck crash on Hume
item.description: Police laid two additional charges of manslaughter and cause bodily harm by misconduct. Image: NSW Police A truckie has been charged with two additional offences, including manslaughter, following a fatal four-truck crash on the Hume Highway near Gundagai, NSW, earlier last year. The incident occurred at around 1.45am on Friday, January 3, 2025, near Spring Dam Road, Coolac, 18km north of Gundagai. item.title: Victorian truck driver turned logistics legend dies aged 83
item.description: Former Victorian truck driver Peter Gunn, inset, founded Cubico in 1969. Images: Gunn family Peter Gunn, the former Victorian truck driver who became a logistics industry giant, has died peacefully on February 26, aged 83, with his family by his side. Gunn began his career in the transport industry working as a truck driver for Fred Brown Transport while studying his BCom degree at the University of Melbourne.
